verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes a documented REST API for setting up and managing the platform programmatically, plus a Connector SDK and even an MCP server for AI agents to query/manage syncs, all first-party documented capabilities enabling AI-native automation. However, the OpenAPI spec discovery probe returned 404s and one community comment flags API reliability issues, and there's no independent hands-on confirmation of API robustness. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent third-party validation of API reliability and completeness.
